scripts.text:
[Holink]
I am the meow~ Blacksmith Holink~
Master of refining, Holink~
I am the special cat Holink who learned from Morocc~
My daughter is so proud of me, Holink~
What should Holink~ refine today?
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵~我是鐵匠霍林克~
精煉大師霍林克~
在夢羅克學藝的特別貓咪霍林克~
女兒最為我驕傲啦，霍林克~
今天讓霍林克精煉什麼喵~？

scripts.text: [Holink]
scripts.translation: [霍林克]

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow? You talking about the other head parts, meow?~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵？你在說其他的頭部裝備，喵？~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow? Where is the accessory?
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵？飾品在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Kyang~! Do not mess with my sensitive olfactory, meow~.
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵嗚~！別刺激我敏感的鼻子喵~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow? You don't have anything on.
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵？你身上什麼都沒穿。

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow? What do you want me to do with this right hand...?
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵？你想精煉右手上的什麼東西...？

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow? What do you want me to do with this left hand...?
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵？你想精煉左手上的什麼東西...？

scripts.text:
[Holink]
There's nothing to see here, meow!!
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
這裡沒什麼好看的，喵！！

scripts.text:
[Holink]
My teacher Aragam said meow~
There's no cure for stupidity...
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
我的老師阿拉甘說過喵~
愚蠢是沒藥醫的...

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Even Aragam can't refine such a thing, meow.
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
連阿拉甘都無法精煉這種東西，喵。

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow~ Perfect refining. Did Aragam do this, meow?~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵~完美的精煉。這是阿拉甘做的嗎，喵？~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
You have chosen an armor, meow~
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff999915000^000000 Zeny for this refine, meow~
Want to continue, meow?~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
你選擇了一件防具，喵~
這次精煉需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff999915000^000000 Zeny，喵~
要繼續嗎，喵？~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow Meow~~ A level 3 weapon~~
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff999920000^000000 Zeny for this refine, meow~
Want to continue, meow?~

[Holink]
Meow, a level 2 weapon...?
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff99992000^000000 Zeny for this refine, meow~
Want to continue, meow?~

[Holink]
A level 1 weapon...?
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999500^000000 Zeny for this refine, meow~
Want to continue, meow?~

[Holink]
Me-Meow!... A level 4 weapon...!
I've only seen it twice while
learning from Aragam... Me-Meow!!
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff999950000^000000 Zeny for this refine, meow~
Want to continue, meow?~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵-喵！...4級武器...！
我跟阿拉甘學藝時只見過兩次...喵-喵！！
這次精煉需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff999950000^000000 Zeny，喵~
要繼續嗎，喵？~

scripts.text: [Holink]
scripts.translation: [霍林克]

scripts.text:
[Holink]
You have chosen an armor, meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
你選擇了一件防具，喵~

scripts.text: Yes!!
scripts.translation: 是的！！

scripts.text: No!!

[Holink]
Kyack!!
You don't believe in refine master Holink, meow?~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵嗚！！
你不相信精煉大師霍林克，喵？~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow!!
Danger. Danger~
This weapon was refined a lot, meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵！！危險，危險~
這把武器的精煉值已經很高了喵~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow!!
This armor was already refined so many times, meow.
You might break it if you continue
to try refining this item further, meow.
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵！！這件防具的精煉值已經很高了，再繼續可能會損毀喵。

scripts.text:
[Holink]
You might break it if you continue
to try refining this item further, meow.
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
再繼續精煉，可能會損毀喵。

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Once the armor is broken, you can
never use it again, meow. Not to mention... all current
^ff0000cards and enchantments will vanish for sure^000000.
You still want to try, meow~?
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
防具一旦損壞，就再也不能用了，喵。更不用說...現有的
^ff0000卡片和附魔肯定都會消失^000000。
還要試嗎，喵~？

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Once the weapon is broken, you can
never use it again, meow. Not to mention... all current
^ff0000cards and enchantments will vanish for sure^000000.
You still want to try, meow~?
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
武器一旦損壞，就再也不能用了，喵。更不用說...現有的
^ff0000卡片和附魔肯定都會消失^000000。
還要試嗎，喵~？

scripts.text: Yes, I do!!
scripts.translation: 是的，我要！！

scripts.text: Forget about it!!
scripts.translation: 算了吧！！

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow! Wise choice, meow.
But!!
I am not happy to see you doubting the refine master Holink, meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵，明智的選擇！
但是！！懷疑精煉大師霍林克，我可不高興喵~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
You don't have the ingredients.
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff999915000^000000 Zeny, meow~
Go get it, meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
你沒有足夠的材料。
需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff999915000^000000 Zeny，喵~
去準備好，喵~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
You don't have the ingredients.
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff999920000^000000 Zeny, meow~
Go get it, meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
你沒有足夠的材料。
需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff999920000^000000 Zeny，喵~
去準備好，喵~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
You don't have the ingredients.
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff99992000^000000 Zeny, meow~
Go get it, meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
你沒有足夠的材料。
需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff99992000^000000 Zeny，喵~
去準備好，喵~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
You don't have the ingredients.
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999500^000000 Zeny, meow~
Go get it, meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
你沒有足夠的材料。
需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff9999500^000000 Zeny，喵~
去準備好，喵~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
You don't have the ingredients.
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff999950000^000000 Zeny, meow~
Go get it, meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
你沒有足夠的材料。
需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff999950000^000000 Zeny，喵~
去準備好，喵~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
等一下...
你覺得我傻嗎？！
趁我不注意你換了物品！給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Me~ Me~ Meow! Fun fun refining~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵~喵~喵！精煉真有趣喵~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Perfect!! Perfect, meow!!
I am the disciple of the refining wizard Aragam~
Holink!!
Another day of successful refining, meow!!
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
完美！！完美喵！！
我可是精煉奇才阿拉甘的弟子，霍林克！！
今天也精煉成功了喵！！

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meo~ Meow~ Kyaaak!!
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵~喵~喵嗚！！

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow!! Aaaaakk~~!!!!
Kyaaak!! I have failed, meow!!
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵！！啊啊啊~~！！！！
喵嗚！！我失敗了，喵！！

scripts.text:
[Holink]
......
......
All~ Everything~ Broken, meow...
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
...
...
全都~全都~壞掉了喵...

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow.... Master Aragam once said,
learn from your failures...
Human, this one failure will be the beginning of your success in the future.
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵...阿拉甘老師說過，要從失敗中學習...
人類，這一次失敗，就是你今後成功的起點。
